### 🛠️ Environment Setup & Dependency Verification
This notebook includes verified dependencies to ensure reproducible execution.

- **Automatic Setup:** Cell 2 verifies Python version compatibility and installs verified package versions sequentially.
- **Network Notice:** Active internet access is required to download uncached packages.

================================================================================

--- [ STEP 2: PASTE INTO CELL 2 (CODE) ] ---

# =====================================================================
# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)
# =====================================================================

import sys
import subprocess
import tempfile
import importlib.metadata

REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)
CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)

# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning
if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:
    req_ver = f"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}"
    curr_ver = f"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}"
    print(f"⚠️ This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.")
    print(f"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\n")

# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)
STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'PyYAML', 'version': '6.0.3', 'flags': []}, {'name': 'beautifulsoup4', 'version': '4.15.0', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': {'has_gpu': False, 'framework': None, 'device_name': None, 'frameworks_detected': ['torch'], 'probe_errors': []}, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}

# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:
# numpy (imported as 'numpy'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# opencv-python (imported as 'cv2'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# scikit-learn (imported as 'sklearn'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# Pillow (imported as 'PIL'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# cupy (optional or conditional dependency inside try/except block)
# umap (imported as 'umap'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# this_package_does_not_exist_xyz (optional or conditional dependency inside try/except block)
# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)

print(f"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...")
print("💡 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\n")

passed_count = 0
failed_packages = []
any_install_performed = False
total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"])
installed_baseline = {}

def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):
    captured = []
    returncode = 0
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as tmp_out:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            returncode = proc.returncode
            tmp_out.seek(0)
            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    captured.append(line)
                    print(f"    {line}")
            sys.stdout.flush()
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).")
        print(f"    ❌ Installation timed out after {timeout}s.")
    except Exception as exc:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Execution failed: {exc}")
        print(f"    ❌ Execution failed: {exc}")
    return returncode, captured

for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"], start=1):
    name = item["name"]
    ver = item.get("version", "")
    flags = item.get("flags", [])
    specifier = f"{name}=={ver}" if ver else name

    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection
    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)
    already_satisfied = False
    try:
        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        if not ver or current_ver == ver:
            already_satisfied = True
            passed_count += 1
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
            print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] ⚡ {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment")
    except Exception:
        pass

    if already_satisfied:
        continue

    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection
    # Flags explanation:
    # - "--no-input": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin
    # - "--disable-pip-version-check": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases
    # - "--no-warn-script-location": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install",
        "--no-input",
        "--disable-pip-version-check",
        "--no-warn-script-location",
        specifier
    ] + flags

    print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] 📦 Installing {specifier}...")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)

    if returncode == 0:
        passed_count += 1
        any_install_performed = True
        print(f"    ✅ {specifier} installed successfully")
        
        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies
        try:
            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
        except Exception:
            pass

        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):
            if prev_pkg == name:
                continue
            try:
                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)
                if active_now != prev_ver:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} ➔ {active_now}")
                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else "Unknown pip error"
        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, "\n".join(captured_output)))
        print(f"    ❌ {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})")
        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get("custom_sourced", []):
            print(f"       ⚠️ This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).")
            print(f"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.")
        print(f"       ├─ Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}")
        if flags:
            print(f"       ├─ Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}")
        print(f"       └─ Error: {err_snippet}\n")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
if not failed_packages:
    print(f"✅ Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.")
else:
    print(f"⚠️ Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.")
    print("Troubleshooting Steps:")
    print("1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.")
    print("2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'")
    print(f"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md")

if any_install_performed:
    print("\n⚠️ Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.")
print("=" * 60)

    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",

    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",

    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",

    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",

    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",

    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",

    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",

    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",

    "    captured = []\n",

    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",

    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",

    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",

    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",

### 🛠️ Environment Setup & Dependency Verification
This notebook includes verified dependencies to ensure reproducible execution.

- **Automatic Setup:** Cell 2 verifies Python version compatibility and installs verified package versions sequentially.
- **Network Notice:** Active internet access is required to download uncached packages.

================================================================================

--- [ STEP 2: PASTE INTO CELL 2 (CODE) ] ---

# =====================================================================
# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)
# =====================================================================

import sys
import subprocess
import tempfile
import importlib.metadata

REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)
CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)

# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning
if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:
    req_ver = f"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}"
    curr_ver = f"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}"
    print(f"⚠️ This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.")
    print(f"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\n")

# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)
STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}

# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:
# gdown (imported as 'gdown'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# awscli (imported as 'awscli'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# spacy (imported as 'spacy'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# onnxruntime (imported as 'onnxruntime'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)
# kaggle-environments (imported as 'kaggle-environments'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)

# --- WRITEFILE SCRIPT DEPENDENCIES ---
# pandas  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile; not found in active env)
# requests==2.34.2  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile)

print(f"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...")
print("💡 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\n")

passed_count = 0
failed_packages = []
any_install_performed = False
total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"])
installed_baseline = {}

def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):
    captured = []
    returncode = 0
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as tmp_out:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            returncode = proc.returncode
            tmp_out.seek(0)
            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    captured.append(line)
                    print(f"    {line}")
            sys.stdout.flush()
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).")
        print(f"    ❌ Installation timed out after {timeout}s.")
    except Exception as exc:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Execution failed: {exc}")
        print(f"    ❌ Execution failed: {exc}")
    return returncode, captured

for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"], start=1):
    name = item["name"]
    ver = item.get("version", "")
    flags = item.get("flags", [])
    specifier = f"{name}=={ver}" if ver else name

    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection
    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)
    already_satisfied = False
    try:
        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        if not ver or current_ver == ver:
            already_satisfied = True
            passed_count += 1
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
            print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] ⚡ {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment")
    except Exception:
        pass

    if already_satisfied:
        continue

    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection
    # Flags explanation:
    # - "--no-input": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin
    # - "--disable-pip-version-check": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases
    # - "--no-warn-script-location": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install",
        "--no-input",
        "--disable-pip-version-check",
        "--no-warn-script-location",
        specifier
    ] + flags

    print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] 📦 Installing {specifier}...")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)

    if returncode == 0:
        passed_count += 1
        any_install_performed = True
        print(f"    ✅ {specifier} installed successfully")
        
        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies
        try:
            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
        except Exception:
            pass

        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):
            if prev_pkg == name:
                continue
            try:
                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)
                if active_now != prev_ver:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} ➔ {active_now}")
                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else "Unknown pip error"
        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, "\n".join(captured_output)))
        print(f"    ❌ {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})")
        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get("custom_sourced", []):
            print(f"       ⚠️ This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).")
            print(f"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.")
        print(f"       ├─ Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}")
        if flags:
            print(f"       ├─ Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}")
        print(f"       └─ Error: {err_snippet}\n")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
if not failed_packages:
    print(f"✅ Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.")
else:
    print(f"⚠️ Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.")
    print("Troubleshooting Steps:")
    print("1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.")
    print("2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'")
    print(f"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md")

if any_install_performed:
    print("\n⚠️ Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.")
print("=" * 60)

# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning
if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:
    req_ver = f"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}"
    curr_ver = f"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}"
    print(f"⚠️ This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.")

passed_count = 0
failed_packages = []
any_install_performed = False
total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"])
installed_baseline = {}

def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):
    captured = []
    returncode = 0
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as tmp_out:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            returncode = proc.returncode
            tmp_out.seek(0)
            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    captured.append(line)
                    print(f"    {line}")
            sys.stdout.flush()
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).")
        print(f"    ❌ Installation timed out after {timeout}s.")
    except Exception as exc:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Execution failed: {exc}")
        print(f"    ❌ Execution failed: {exc}")
    return returncode, captured

for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"], start=1):
    name = item["name"]
    ver = item.get("version", "")
    flags = item.get("flags", [])
    specifier = f"{name}=={ver}" if ver else name

    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection
    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)
    already_satisfied = False
    try:
        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        if not ver or current_ver == ver:
            already_satisfied = True
            passed_count += 1
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
            print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] ⚡ {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment")
    except Exception:
        pass

    if already_satisfied:
        continue

    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection
    # Flags explanation:
    # - "--no-input": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin
    # - "--disable-pip-version-check": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases
    # - "--no-warn-script-location": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install",
        "--no-input",
        "--disable-pip-version-check",
        "--no-warn-script-location",
        specifier
    ] + flags

    print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] 📦 Installing {specifier}...")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)

    if returncode == 0:
        passed_count += 1
        any_install_performed = True
        print(f"    ✅ {specifier} installed successfully")
        
        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies
        try:
            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
        except Exception:
            pass

        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):
            if prev_pkg == name:
                continue
            try:
                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)
                if active_now != prev_ver:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} ➔ {active_now}")
                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else "Unknown pip error"
        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, "\n".join(captured_output)))
        print(f"    ❌ {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})")
        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get("custom_sourced", []):
            print(f"       ⚠️ This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).")
            print(f"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.")
        print(f"       ├─ Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}")
        if flags:
            print(f"       ├─ Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}")
        print(f"       └─ Error: {err_snippet}\n")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
if not failed_packages:
    print(f"✅ Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.")
else:
    print(f"⚠️ Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.")
    print("Troubleshooting Steps:")
    print("1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.")
    print("2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'")
    print(f"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md")

if any_install_performed:
    print("\n⚠️ Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.")
print("=" * 60)

    req_ver = f"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}"

    returncode = 0
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as tmp_out:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            returncode = proc.returncode
            tmp_out.seek(0)
            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    captured.append(line)
                    print(f"    {line}")
            sys.stdout.flush()
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).")
        print(f"    ❌ Installation timed out after {timeout}s.")
    except Exception as exc:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Execution failed: {exc}")
        print(f"    ❌ Execution failed: {exc}")
    return returncode, captured

for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"], start=1):
    name = item["name"]
    ver = item.get("version", "")
    flags = item.get("flags", [])
    specifier = f"{name}=={ver}" if ver else name

    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection
    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)
    already_satisfied = False
    try:
        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        if not ver or current_ver == ver:
            already_satisfied = True
            passed_count += 1
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
            print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] ⚡ {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment")
    except Exception:
        pass

    if already_satisfied:
        continue

    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection
    # Flags explanation:
    # - "--no-input": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin
    # - "--disable-pip-version-check": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases
    # - "--no-warn-script-location": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install",
        "--no-input",
        "--disable-pip-version-check",
        "--no-warn-script-location",
        specifier
    ] + flags

    print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] 📦 Installing {specifier}...")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 5)

    if returncode == 0:
        passed_count += 1
        any_install_performed = True
        print(f"    ✅ {specifier} installed successfully")
        
        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies
        try:
            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
        except Exception:
            pass

        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):
            if prev_pkg == name:
                continue
            try:
                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)
                if active_now != prev_ver:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} ➔ {active_now}")
                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else "Unknown pip error"
        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, "\n".join(captured_output)))
        print(f"    ❌ {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})")
        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get("custom_sourced", []):
            print(f"       ⚠️ This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).")
            print(f"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.")
        print(f"       ├─ Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}")
        if flags:
            print(f"       ├─ Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}")
        print(f"       └─ Error: {err_snippet}\n")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
if not failed_packages:
    print(f"✅ Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.")
else:

### 🛠️ Environment Setup & Dependency Verification
This notebook includes verified dependencies to ensure reproducible execution.

- **Automatic Setup:** Cell 2 verifies Python version compatibility and installs verified package versions sequentially.
- **Network Notice:** Active internet access is required to download uncached packages.

================================================================================

--- [ STEP 2: PASTE INTO CELL 2 (CODE) ] ---

# =====================================================================
# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)
# =====================================================================

import sys
import subprocess
import tempfile
import importlib.metadata

REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)
CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)

# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning
if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:
    req_ver = f"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}"
    curr_ver = f"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}"
    print(f"⚠️ This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.")
    print(f"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\n")

# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)
STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}

# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:
# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)

print(f"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...")
print("💡 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\n")

passed_count = 0
failed_packages = []
any_install_performed = False
total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"])
installed_baseline = {}

def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):
    captured = []
    returncode = 0
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as tmp_out:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            returncode = proc.returncode
            tmp_out.seek(0)
            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    captured.append(line)
                    print(f"    {line}")
            sys.stdout.flush()
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).")
        print(f"    ❌ Installation timed out after {timeout}s.")
    except Exception as exc:
        returncode = -1
        captured.append(f"Execution failed: {exc}")
        print(f"    ❌ Execution failed: {exc}")
    return returncode, captured

for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST["dependencies"], start=1):
    name = item["name"]
    ver = item.get("version", "")
    flags = item.get("flags", [])
    specifier = f"{name}=={ver}" if ver else name

    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection
    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)
    already_satisfied = False
    try:
        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        if not ver or current_ver == ver:
            already_satisfied = True
            passed_count += 1
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
            print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] ⚡ {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment")
    except Exception:
        pass

    if already_satisfied:
        continue

    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection
    # Flags explanation:
    # - "--no-input": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin
    # - "--disable-pip-version-check": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases
    # - "--no-warn-script-location": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install",
        "--no-input",
        "--disable-pip-version-check",
        "--no-warn-script-location",
        specifier
    ] + flags

    print(f"[{idx}/{total_deps}] 📦 Installing {specifier}...")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)

    if returncode == 0:
        passed_count += 1
        any_install_performed = True
        print(f"    ✅ {specifier} installed successfully")
        
        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies
        try:
            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)
            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver
        except Exception:
            pass

        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):
            if prev_pkg == name:
                continue
            try:
                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)
                if active_now != prev_ver:
                    print(f"   ⚠️ Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} ➔ {active_now}")
                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else "Unknown pip error"
        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, "\n".join(captured_output)))
        print(f"    ❌ {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})")
        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get("custom_sourced", []):
            print(f"       ⚠️ This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).")
            print(f"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.")
        print(f"       ├─ Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}")
        if flags:
            print(f"       ├─ Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}")
        print(f"       └─ Error: {err_snippet}\n")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
if not failed_packages:
    print(f"✅ Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.")
else:
    print(f"⚠️ Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.")
    print("Troubleshooting Steps:")
    print("1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.")
    print("2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'")
    print(f"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md")

if any_install_performed:
    print("\n⚠️ Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.")
print("=" * 60)

            print(f"       ⚠️ This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).")
            print(f"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.")
        print(f"       ├─ Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}")
        if flags:
            print(f"       ├─ Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}")
        print(f"       └─ Error: {err_snippet}\n")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
if not failed_packages:
    print(f"✅ Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.")
else:
    print(f"⚠️ Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.")
    print("Troubleshooting Steps:")
    print("1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.")
    print("2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'")
    print(f"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md")

if any_install_performed:
    print("\n⚠️ Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.")
print("=" * 60)

    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# gdown (imported as 'gdown'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# awscli (imported as 'awscli'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# spacy (imported as 'spacy'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# onnxruntime (imported as 'onnxruntime'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# kaggle-environments (imported as 'kaggle-environments'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- WRITEFILE SCRIPT DEPENDENCIES ---\n",
    "# pandas  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile; not found in active env)\n",
    "# requests==2.34.2  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"
   ]

    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",

    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# gdown (imported as 'gdown'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# awscli (imported as 'awscli'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# spacy (imported as 'spacy'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# onnxruntime (imported as 'onnxruntime'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# kaggle-environments (imported as 'kaggle-environments'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- WRITEFILE SCRIPT DEPENDENCIES ---\n",
    "# pandas  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile; not found in active env)\n",
    "# requests==2.34.2  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"

    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"

    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",

    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",

    "                continue\n",

    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",

    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",

    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"
