    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",

    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",

    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",

    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",

   "cell_type": "code",

    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# gdown (imported as 'gdown'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# awscli (imported as 'awscli'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# spacy (imported as 'spacy'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# onnxruntime (imported as 'onnxruntime'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# kaggle-environments (imported as 'kaggle-environments'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- WRITEFILE SCRIPT DEPENDENCIES ---\n",
    "# pandas  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile; not found in active env)\n",
    "# requests==2.34.2  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",

    "### \ud83d\udee0\ufe0f Environment Setup & Dependency Verification\n",
    "This notebook includes verified dependencies to ensure reproducible execution.\n",
    "\n",
    "- **Automatic Setup:** Cell 2 verifies Python version compatibility and installs verified package versions sequentially.\n",

   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "<CELLID>",
   "metadata": {
    "steady_py": {
     "managed": true,
     "role": "setup_code"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 5)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"
   ]

    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",

    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",

    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",

    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",

    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# gdown (imported as 'gdown'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# awscli (imported as 'awscli'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# spacy (imported as 'spacy'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# onnxruntime (imported as 'onnxruntime'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# kaggle-environments (imported as 'kaggle-environments'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- WRITEFILE SCRIPT DEPENDENCIES ---\n",
    "# pandas  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile; not found in active env)\n",
    "# requests==2.34.2  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"

    "# VERIFIED ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCIES (<TS>)\n",
    "# =====================================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# torch (imported as 'torch'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",

    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",

    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"

    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",

    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"

    "import subprocess\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",
    "# Informational notes & uninstalled fallbacks:\n",
    "# gdown (imported as 'gdown'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",
    "# awscli (imported as 'awscli'; not found via pip-freeze or local file scan -- verify before assuming this is truly missing)\n",

    "# pandas  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile; not found in active env)\n",
    "# requests==2.34.2  (imported inside script generated via %%writefile)\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- FULL FREEZE FALLBACK BLOCK ---\n",
    "FULL_FREEZE_FALLBACK = ['anyio==4.14.2', 'asttokens==3.0.2', 'attrs==26.1.0', 'beautifulsoup4==4.15.0', 'bleach==6.4.0', 'certifi==2026.6.17', 'charset-normalizer==3.4.9', 'click==8.4.2', 'colorama==0.4.6', 'comm==0.2.3', 'coverage==7.16.0', 'debugpy==1.8.21', 'decorator==5.3.1', 'defusedxml==0.7.1', 'entrypoints==0.4', 'executing==2.2.1', 'fastjsonschema==2.21.2', 'filelock==3.32.2', 'fsspec==2026.7.0', 'h11==0.16.0', 'hf-xet==1.6.0', 'httpcore==1.0.9', 'httpx==0.28.1', 'huggingface_hub==1.27.0', 'idna==3.18', 'iniconfig==2.3.0', 'ipykernel==7.3.0', 'ipython==9.15.0', 'ipython_pygments_lexers==1.1.1', 'jedi==0.20.0', 'Jinja2==3.1.6', 'jsonschema==4.26.0', 'jsonschema-specifications==2025.9.1', 'jupyter_client==8.9.1', 'jupyter_core==5.9.1', 'jupyterlab_pygments==0.3.0', 'MarkupSafe==3.0.3', 'matplotlib-inline==0.2.2', 'mistune==3.3.3', 'nbclient==0.11.0', 'nbconvert==7.17.1', 'nbformat==5.10.4', 'nest-asyncio2==1.7.2', 'packaging==26.2', 'pandocfilters==1.5.1', 'papermill==2.7.0', 'parso==0.8.7', 'platformdirs==4.10.1', 'pluggy==1.6.0', 'prompt_toolkit==3.0.52', 'psutil==7.2.2', 'pure_eval==0.2.3', 'Pygments==2.20.0', 'pytest==9.1.1', 'pytest-cov==7.1.0', 'python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0', 'PyYAML==6.0.3', 'pyzmq==27.1.0', 'referencing==0.37.0', 'requests==2.34.2', 'resolvelib==1.2.1', 'rpds-py==2026.6.3', 'six==1.17.0', 'soupsieve==2.9', 'stack-data==0.6.3', 'tenacity==9.1.4', 'tinycss2==1.5.1', 'tornado==6.5.7', 'tqdm==4.69.0', 'traitlets==5.15.1', 'typing_extensions==4.16.0', 'urllib3==2.7.0', 'wcwidth==0.8.2', 'webencodings==0.5.1']\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"
   ]

    "import tempfile\n",
    "import importlib.metadata\n",
    "\n",
    "REQUIRED_PYTHON = (3, 13)\n",
    "CURRENT_PYTHON = (sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Any Python version mismatch -> non-blocking warning\n",
    "if CURRENT_PYTHON != REQUIRED_PYTHON:\n",
    "    req_ver = f\"{REQUIRED_PYTHON[0]}.{REQUIRED_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    curr_ver = f\"{CURRENT_PYTHON[0]}.{CURRENT_PYTHON[1]}\"\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f This code was created with Python {req_ver}. You are trying to run it with {curr_ver}.\")\n",
    "    print(f\"If installation fails, consider changing your runtime Python version back to {req_ver}.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reproducibility manifest (dependencies, Python target, GPU context, integrity hash)\n",
    "STEADY_PY_MANIFEST = {'python_version': {'major': 3, 'minor': 13}, 'dependencies': [{'name': 'requests', 'version': '2.34.2', 'flags': []}], 'gpu': None, 'generated_at': '<TS>', 'tool_version': '44', 'dependency_hash': '<HASH>', 'raw_installs': [], 'custom_sourced': [], 'local_modules': [], 'baseline': {'version': 1, 'findings': [], 'errors': []}}\n",
    "\n",

    "\n",
    "print(f\"Applying verified environment dependencies [<TS>]...\")\n",
    "print(\"\ud83d\udca1 Note: Dependencies are installed sequentially to prevent index conflicts.\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "passed_count = 0\n",
    "failed_packages = []\n",
    "any_install_performed = False\n",
    "total_deps = len(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"])\n",
    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u26a0\ufe0f This package is custom-specified by the notebook's author (not on public PyPI).\")\n",
    "            print(f\"          If it's unavailable, contact the author for its current location.\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Author Verified Version: {ver or 'unspecified'}\")\n",
    "        if flags:\n",
    "            print(f\"       \u251c\u2500 Scoped Flags: {' '.join(flags)}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"       \u2514\u2500 Error: {err_snippet}\\n\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
    "if not failed_packages:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u2705 Setup complete! All {passed_count}/{total_deps} dependencies verified.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Setup completed with issues: {passed_count}/{total_deps} packages installed.\")\n",
    "    print(\"Troubleshooting Steps:\")\n",
    "    print(\"1. Internet Access: Ensure your notebook environment has active internet access.\")\n",
    "    print(\"2. Unpinned Installs: Test installing failed libraries manually: '!pip install <pkg>'\")\n",
    "    print(f\"3. Troubleshooting Steps: For a detailed guide on resolving setup errors, see: https://github.com/flyinacres/notebook_env/blob/main/HELP.md\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if any_install_performed:\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\u26a0\ufe0f Note: You may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n"

    "installed_baseline = {}\n",
    "\n",
    "def _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, timeout):\n",
    "    captured = []\n",
    "    returncode = 0\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode=\"w+\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as tmp_out:\n",
    "            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=tmp_out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)\n",
    "            returncode = proc.returncode\n",
    "            tmp_out.seek(0)\n",
    "            for line in tmp_out.read().splitlines():\n",
    "                if line.strip():\n",
    "                    captured.append(line)\n",
    "                    print(f\"    {line}\")\n",
    "            sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Error: installation exceeded per-package timeout limit ({timeout}s).\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Installation timed out after {timeout}s.\")\n",
    "    except Exception as exc:\n",
    "        returncode = -1\n",
    "        captured.append(f\"Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c Execution failed: {exc}\")\n",
    "    return returncode, captured\n",
    "\n",
    "for idx, item in enumerate(STEADY_PY_MANIFEST[\"dependencies\"], start=1):\n",
    "    name = item[\"name\"]\n",
    "    ver = item.get(\"version\", \"\")\n",
    "    flags = item.get(\"flags\", [])\n",
    "    specifier = f\"{name}=={ver}\" if ver else name\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 1: Pre-install inspection\n",
    "    # Avoids redundant re-installations in pre-configured platforms (Colab, Kaggle)\n",
    "    already_satisfied = False\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "        if not ver or current_ver == ver:\n",
    "            already_satisfied = True\n",
    "            passed_count += 1\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "            print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \u26a1 {name} ({current_ver}) already satisfied in environment\")\n",
    "    except Exception:\n",
    "        pass\n",
    "\n",
    "    if already_satisfied:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Step 2: Non-blocking installation via disk-backed stream redirection\n",
    "    # Flags explanation:\n",
    "    # - \"--no-input\": Prevents pip from prompting on stdin\n",
    "    # - \"--disable-pip-version-check\": Eliminates overhead checking for newer pip releases\n",
    "    # - \"--no-warn-script-location\": Suppresses path warnings for local bin paths\n",
    "    cmd = [\n",
    "        sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\",\n",
    "        \"--no-input\",\n",
    "        \"--disable-pip-version-check\",\n",
    "        \"--no-warn-script-location\",\n",
    "        specifier\n",
    "    ] + flags\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"[{idx}/{total_deps}] \ud83d\udce6 Installing {specifier}...\")\n",
    "    sys.stdout.flush()\n",
    "\n",
    "    returncode, captured_output = _run_pip_subprocess(cmd, 120)\n",
    "\n",
    "    if returncode == 0:\n",
    "        passed_count += 1\n",
    "        any_install_performed = True\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u2705 {specifier} installed successfully\")\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Real-time drift audit across previously installed dependencies\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            current_ver = importlib.metadata.version(name)\n",
    "            installed_baseline[name] = current_ver\n",
    "        except Exception:\n",
    "            pass\n",
    "\n",
    "        for prev_pkg, prev_ver in list(installed_baseline.items()):\n",
    "            if prev_pkg == name:\n",
    "                continue\n",
    "            try:\n",
    "                active_now = importlib.metadata.version(prev_pkg)\n",
    "                if active_now != prev_ver:\n",
    "                    print(f\"   \u26a0\ufe0f Dependency Drift: Installing '{specifier}' caused '{prev_pkg}' to drift from {prev_ver} \u2794 {active_now}\")\n",
    "                    installed_baseline[prev_pkg] = active_now\n",
    "            except Exception:\n",
    "                pass\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        err_snippet = captured_output[-1] if captured_output else \"Unknown pip error\"\n",
    "        failed_packages.append((specifier, ver, flags, \"\\n\".join(captured_output)))\n",
    "        print(f\"    \u274c {specifier} failed to install (exit code {returncode})\")\n",
    "        if name in STEADY_PY_MANIFEST.get(\"custom_sourced\", []):\n",

    "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n",
